overall_goal: Add the squash to the frying pan and fry it.

goals.description: Add the squash to the frying pan and perform an initial stir.
goals.rationale: The person pours the chunks of squash into the pan, sets the empty bowl aside, and uses a spatula to mix the squash with the onions to distribute the oil.

goals.description: Fry the squash while stirring occasionally and adjusting the heat.
goals.rationale: The person continues to cook the squash, adjusting the hob temperature and periodically stirring the food to ensure even cooking and prevent sticking.
